discretionary_detail: No discretionary portfolio management mandate found on private banking, priority or wealth pages. ADIB Capital's described DFSA activities are arranging, advising and managing collective investment funds (CG Report 2025).

private_markets_detail: ADIB Alternative Investments: 'single or co-investment with a group of other investors' for 'highly sophisticated clients' willing to lock up capital; no managers or asset classes named. The Diamond wealth page lists private equity, alternative investments and real estate advisory.

Shariah funds, sukuk (primary retail T-Sukuk, fractional and secondary), Wakala structured notes and Shariah-compliant stock lists at ADIB Securities. Industry awards include 'Best Islamic Wealth Manager' (IFN 2025 poll) and 'Islamic Wealth Manager of the Year' (The Asset Triple A).

The H1 2026 deck gives the treasury head's title as 'Head of Treasury, Asset Management & Global Markets'. CBD Invest is offered under CBD's 'Securities Portfolio Management' licence.

Its FAQ states there is no international market access. US-listed stocks and ETFs are offered separately through CBD Invest: CBD transmits orders and Saxo Bank acts as executing broker. CBD says it does not act as broker or dealer for these trades.
digital_investing_detail: CBD Invest launched in the CBD Mobile App around 29–30 Jul 2026 and is not available on internet banking. It offers 7,000+ US-listed stocks and ETFs through market, limit, stop and recurring buy orders, with no fractional shares. Other features: 'Wealth 360' net worth including manually added external assets and liabilities, goal 'Spaces', analytics benchmarked to the S&P 500 and NASDAQ, and a daily portfolio score. It is for UAE residents aged 21+ (not US nationals) with a CBD current or savings account, after CMA investor classification and appropriateness checks. Fees are 0.25% of trade value (min USD 3), with 0% commission promoted for new customers. It is execution-only with no advice. The legacy CBD Investr app page now redirects to CBD Invest.
advisory_detail: The launch release says Elite and Private Banking clients get dedicated relationship managers and 'specialist investment expertise' for portfolio construction and long-term planning. No advisory mandate or fee schedule was published. CBD Invest explicitly provides no advice.
discretionary_detail: No discretionary portfolio management offering found. The CBD Invest KFS states CBD does not provide discretionary portfolio management under that service.

funds_platform_detail: The website menu has a 'Mutual Funds' page, but it rendered blank on 2026-10-12, so the fund shelf and platform provider are unknown. CBD Invest offers ETFs only.

The FY2025 annual report says the private banking proposition 'advanced into a more integrated and relationship-led ecosystem' for HNW and UHNW clients, combining wealth advisory, lifestyle privileges and multi-generational legacy planning, and lists private banking as a 2026 priority. In 2019 the bank signed an alliance with EFG International that gave Omani clients access to a Swiss private banking relationship; its current status is unknown.
asset_management_detail: This is in-house, not a separate entity: 'funds management' sits in the Investment Banking segment. FSA licences cover Investment Manager, Portfolio Management, Fund Administration and Custodian. Fiduciary 'assets under management' (including custody) were OMR 1,805m at 30 Jun 2026. In Sep 2026 E-Fund named the bank its exclusive partner to market E-Fund products through its 'Asset Management and Origination & Placement businesses'. Pending: up to 55% of Neo Group Limited KSA (CMA-licensed asset management and advisory). No in-house fund names were found.
brokerage_detail: The FSA register does not list Brokerage among Sohar International's licensed securities activities. No brokerage or trading service was found on sib.om.
digital_investing_detail: 2025 mobile app enhancements cover goal-based savings, bill payments, recurring transfers and Google, Apple and Samsung Pay. An Open Banking API platform was launched in 2025. No investing feature was found in the app or on the site.
advisory_detail: Wealth Management offers a dedicated RM and a 'personalized wealth advisory service'. The bank holds an FSA Investment Advice & Research licence. A Government Investment Advisory unit was set up in 2025 for institutional clients.
discretionary_detail: The FSA Portfolio Management licence and the fiduciary note's 'portfolio and investment management' indicate managed portfolios, but no client-facing discretionary mandate product is described.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: None found on sib.om or in the annual report.
funds_platform_detail: Wealth clients get 'access to investment products' (not specified). E-Fund products are to be marketed under the Sep 2026 partnership (announced). The 2019 EFG International alliance gave access to EFG's product shelf. No live third-party fund list was found.
structured_products_detail: Structured Deposits are listed on the Wealth 'Global Market' page. The bank holds an FSA licence as Issuer of Structured Instruments. Terms are not published.
private_markets_detail: MoU with Templewater (Asia/GCC alternatives manager), 10 Sep 2026, covering investment opportunities for eligible Sohar clients and potential co-investments. It is not yet a product.
islamic_wealth_detail: Sohar Islamic has 21 branches with Islamic deposits, financing and cards. No Shariah-compliant investment or wealth product was found.
asset_classes: Bonds; Structured products

private_banking_detail: Not a bank. HNW coverage through Wealth Management relationship managers; leverage arranged through tie-ups with local and international banks.
asset_management_detail: Discretionary country-specific equity, regional equity and fixed income mandates; 'assets over USD 560 million' (undated); team of 5–6. Funds: Tarabut Fund (Shariah balanced, NAV OMR 1.205/unit 8 Oct 2026), The First Mazoon Fund (NAV OMR 1.099/unit 11 Oct 2026; FSA reg. 1/2007), Gheras Endowment Investment Fund (Shariah). FSA register also lists Ubhar as investment and administrative manager of 'Ubar Fund for Gulf Markets (formerly Oman Arab Fund)' (FSA reg. 10/2009).
brokerage_detail: Equity and fixed income brokerage; execution for GCC, MENA, US and European markets and ETFs; international OTC bond trading; institutional sales desk; top-3 MSX broker by market share 2015–2022 (No. 1 in 2017, 2019, 2021). Margin financing licensed. Market maker and liquidity provider: Oman Arab Bank (May 2024), Bank Muscat (from 6 Jul 2025).
digital_investing_detail: Online trading for Omani, GCC and US markets via the u-capitallink.net platform and a mobile app (the homepage links an app listed as 'uinvest'); portfolio viewer and SMS alerts. Launch dates not stated.
advisory_detail: Wealth Management: risk profiling, asset allocation, portfolio review and rebalancing recommendations; FSA activity 'Investment Advice & Research'; research coverage of MSX and GCC companies in Arabic and English.
discretionary_detail: Discretionary portfolio mandates for institutional and HNW clients (FSA activity 'Portfolio Management').
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No model or robo portfolios found on u-capital.net.
funds_platform_detail: Access to global funds and international fixed income via 'best in class global investment managers' (not named); Global Mutual Funds KIDs published on the Wealth Management page; FSA activity 'Marketing non-Omani Securities'. Indian market products via Kotak Mahindra Bank tie-up.
structured_products_detail: FSA-registered 'Issuer of Structured Instruments'; the May 2024 licence release lists issuance of structured instruments among services. Specific notes not published.
private_markets_detail: Corporate Finance & Advisory lists private equity and private placements; parent Jabreen Capital is a private equity firm. No client private-markets fund found.
islamic_wealth_detail: Tarabut Fund (open-ended Shariah-compliant balanced fund: GCC and international Shariah equities and sukuk) and Gheras Endowment Investment Fund (Shariah equities and sukuk for endowment institutions).
asset_classes: Local equities; GCC equities; US/international equities; ETFs; Bonds; Sukuk; Mutual funds; Structured products

private_banking_detail: Dedicated RMs supported by portfolio analysts, offering 'discreet personal asset and liability management', banking solutions and investment solutions. The division reported QR 2.3bn assets and QR 5.6bn liabilities in 2025, and is expanding investment, structured and alternative products through a partnership with an unnamed international investment bank.
asset_management_detail: No asset management subsidiary, proprietary funds or AUM figure was found in the group structure (S3) or on the website.
brokerage_detail: Ahli Brokerage Company L.L.C. (100%; licensed QSE brokerage launched 2011). It offers QSE access through a branch trading floor (Ahli Bank Building, Salwa Road), phone trading, an Internet Trading System, a VIP Trading Lounge for HNWIs, and Reuters order routing for foreign institutional brokers. It has its own mobile app ('Ahli Brokerage Co'). Qatar market only.
digital_investing_detail: Investing is through Ahli Brokerage's Internet Trading System and app (QSE equities only). For Private Banking, the AR 2025 reports 'the rollout of its digital trading platform' giving real-time market access; the platform and provider are not named. No investing in the Ahlibank personal mobile app was found. Retail and corporate digital platforms are being rebuilt; a new corporate platform from an unnamed 'leading provider' was due by mid-2026.
advisory_detail: Private Banking gives 'appropriate and sensitive advice' with portfolio-analyst support, plus advisory and global investment access through an international investment bank partnership. Premium Banking RMs cover 'account and investment management needs'.
discretionary_detail: No discretionary mandate offering was found on the Private Banking pages or in the AR 2025.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: None found.
funds_platform_detail: The 2025 segment note says Private Banking serves HNWIs with 'investment products, funds, credit facilities, trusts, and alternative investments', but no fund shelf or provider is named. Retail customers can reach 180+ funds only inside MetLife unit-linked plans (International Wealth Builder).
structured_products_detail: The AR 2025 says Private Banking is expanding 'investment products, structured solutions and alternative assets'. No issuers or terms are published.
private_markets_detail: 'Alternative investments' and 'alternative assets' appear in the segment note and the AR narrative, with no named products.
islamic_wealth_detail: Conventional bank; no Shari'a-compliant wealth products found.

private_banking_detail: CB Premium Private: invitation-only service with a dedicated private banker, a tailored approach, and meetings with industry-specific financial experts; covers deposits, credit, mortgages, insurance, wealth management, investments and brokerage. Clients are served from CB Premium Lounges. International Banking also serves ultra-high-net-worth family offices outside Qatar. The 2026-2030 strategy prioritises affluent and Private Banking Qatari clients.
asset_management_detail: CB Asset Management L.L.C. (CBAM): wholly owned, capital QAR 50m, QFCRA licence 01179 for investment management, advisory and fund management. It is led by Faisal Qamar Khan with Kamal Farhat as deputy. The group launched and consolidates the Sondook Fund LLC money market fund (2025; QAR 50m of group units plus QAR 50m of external units at 31 Dec 2025), shown on the website as the 'CBAM Sondook Fund'. The website also carries documents for an in-house 'Al Waseela' fund (not reviewed). CBFS has its own Head of Asset Management. No AUM is disclosed.
brokerage_detail: Commercial Bank Financial Services L.L.C. (CBFS): wholly owned, QFMA-regulated. Offers QSE securities trading, margin trading, liquidity provision, Trade Direct online trading, phone trading, a dedicated brokers' lounge and the CB Waseet mobile app (biometric login, instant transfers to CBQ accounts). It began market-making in 2025. International share trading runs through the bank's CB Alpha Trader platform.
digital_investing_detail: CB Alpha Trader (desktop and iOS/Android): trade US, UK, European and Hong Kong markets; the account is opened and funded instantly through internet/mobile banking; 60-day demo account; lower fees announced on the current page; used for the Aug 2026 Young Investors simulation. CB Waseet app for QSE trading through CBFS. The CBQ Mobile App added investment account opening and wealth services in 2025, plus a CB Video Relationship Manager. App NPS is 86. Technology vendor for Alpha Trader not disclosed.
advisory_detail: Accredited, bilingual Wealth Advisors follow a four-step process: financial review, risk profiling (1 Risk Averse to 5 Aggressive), portfolio construction and execution, and periodic review/rebalancing. The Annual Report 2025 cites in-house research, thematic portfolios and tailored advisory.
discretionary_detail: CBAM holds a QFCRA investment management licence, but no discretionary mandate product for retail or private clients is published. The wealth pages describe advisory portfolios with rebalancing discussions.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: The Annual Report 2025 mentions 'thematic portfolios' within advisory, and a 2023 interview said AI-based robo-advisory tools were in development. No live robo or model-portfolio product was found on the website.
funds_platform_detail: Third-party mutual funds from Fidelity International, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock and Kotak (lump sum from USD 3,000 / QAR 10,000), with a published mutual fund catalogue. International Investment Plans (SIP) start at USD 300 plus USD 300 a month. The Annual Report 2025 cites 'strategic distribution partnerships with leading global asset managers'. Platform or custody provider not named.
structured_products_detail: 'Structured Solutions': bespoke notes on equities, indices and commodities from A-rated issuers (issuers not named), with varying capital protection.
private_markets_detail: The website product list includes 'Alternative Investments' (content not reviewed). CBQ has distributed CB Leasing and Finance Funds with WCP Investments (second fund launched Dec 2019; seen in search results only). No current private equity or private credit offer was confirmed.
islamic_wealth_detail: Conventional bank. Its fixed income shelf includes sukuk, and it launched a Shariah-compliant global multi-asset fund managed by Franklin Templeton in 2023 (release seen in search results only).
asset_classes: Local equities; US/international equities; ETFs; Mutual funds; Bonds; Sukuk; Structured products

private_banking_detail: Doha Private Banking gives each client a dedicated private banker, preferential pricing, and an investment account on the Bank of Singapore platform, with Bank of Singapore research and risk profiling. Services cover asset creation and preservation, wealth planning (estate planning, family governance, philanthropy advisory, trust services) and credit solutions, including real estate-backed and structured financing. The AR 2025 describes a move to a relationship-centric advisory model for HNW and UHNW clients, with enhanced global custody and multi-asset execution. The MEED award page reports private banking clients up 18% year on year.
asset_management_detail: No in-house asset management subsidiary in Qatar. Doha Bank founded the QE Index ETF (QETF), which is managed by Aventicum Capital Management (Qatar). Its Indian associate, Doha Brokerage and Financial Services Ltd (35.29%), does brokerage and asset management in India. The Wealth Management Division reports AUM above USD 100m, but this reflects advisory and custody assets, not an asset manager.
brokerage_detail: Not through a Qatar subsidiary. QSE trading: Q-Trade in online and mobile banking links to the client's account at The Group Securities (accounts at other brokers cannot be linked). International: the Treasury & Investments 'International Brokerage' desk covers US, Canada, UK and Europe shares, ETFs and options from USD 5,000, with accounts opened at the Investments department. Margin trading is also offered.
digital_investing_detail: DB Global Markets (DBGM) platform on desktop and mobile: US and European stocks, bonds, FX, metals and commodities; account opening within one business day; 15% margin; revenue QAR 3.2m in 2025 (QAR 1.65m in 2024). Q-Trade gives QSE trading inside Doha Bank online and mobile banking via The Group Securities. The technology vendor for DBGM is not named.
advisory_detail: Private bankers give investment advice, using Bank of Singapore research and risk profiling. Financial planning and estate planning are also offered. The Euromoney 2026 award cites personalised advisory and financial planning.
discretionary_detail: No discretionary mandate offer found on the Private Banking pages, in the AR 2025 or in award coverage.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No robo-advisor or model-portfolio product found.
funds_platform_detail: Third-party mutual funds through the Bank of Singapore platform for Private Banking clients. The Euromoney 2026 'Best for Funds' (Qatar) award cites a diversified range of fund strategies. Shariah-compliant products were added in 2025.
structured_products_detail: Structured products through the Bank of Singapore platform; structured FX, commodity and rates hedging through Global Markets Solutions.
private_markets_detail: Strategic partnership with Blackstone, formed Q2 2025, giving Qatari institutional and HNW clients private equity, real estate, private credit, multi-asset credit and infrastructure strategies. MoU with Carlyle (30 Oct 2024) for evergreen private-markets solutions and an exclusive product for Qatar investors. MoU with KKR (22 Sep 2026) to explore access to KKR private equity, infrastructure, credit and real estate strategies. The Private Banking menu lists hedge funds, private-market funds and private equities. Won MEED 'Best Private Equity Offering - MENA' 2025.
islamic_wealth_detail: Conventional bank; Islamic banking was discontinued in 2011 under a QCB directive. In 2025 the Wealth Management Division introduced Shariah-compliant investment products to attract new clients.
asset_classes: Local equities; US/international equities; ETFs; Mutual funds; Bonds; Structured products; Private markets / alternatives; Gold / precious metals

private_banking_detail: Private Banking & Wealth Management, run by GM Chaouki Daher. Offers a dedicated Private Banker, customised investment plans by risk appetite, portfolio management, mutual funds, capital-protected products, sukuk, private-banker cards (Visa Infinite), treasury and FX, and online banking. Named World's Best Islamic Private Bank by Global Finance in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
asset_management_detail: The First Investor (TFI, 100% subsidiary) does asset management across GCC Shari'a-compliant public equities, a global sukuk fund and segregated sukuk mandates, money market products, and alternatives (real estate funds in Saudi Arabia, Europe and Canada, and private equity). TFI's website claims 'over US$ 1 billion in assets under management' (undated). The bank also runs Discretionary Portfolio Management: QAR 1,090,875k off balance sheet at 30 Sep 2026.
brokerage_detail: No equity brokerage arm or brokerage service was found on the website or in the group structure. Treasury offers sukuk trading, market making and custody for sukuk investors, and TFI offers execution-only sukuk services through international custodians.
digital_investing_detail: Dukhan Mobile offers accounts, transfers (including international via Western Union), time deposits, cards and financing. Private and Prestige clients can 'track investments' but cannot buy them in the app. Euromoney named it Qatar's Best Islamic Digital Bank in 2026.
advisory_detail: Private Bankers build customised investment plans. The Prime tier offers 'Advisory & Discretionary Portfolio Management', local and global investment products, and retirement and succession planning with investment specialists.
discretionary_detail: 'Portfolio Management Services - Qatar, GCC equity markets and Sukuk, managed by a team of local and regional equity specialists'. Off-balance-sheet Discretionary Portfolio Management was QAR 1,254,401k at 31 Dec 2025 and QAR 1,090,875k at 30 Sep 2026.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No model portfolios or robo-advice found on the private banking, Prime or app pages or in the investor presentation.
funds_platform_detail: Private Banking offers 'Mutual funds - Qatar, GCC, Regional and Global funds across different asset classes'. No platform provider is named. TFI runs its own sukuk and money market funds.
structured_products_detail: Capital-protected products linked to equities, commodities and other assets for Private Banking clients. Treasury also offers structured investments linked to FX and to regional and international equities, with varying capital protection.
private_markets_detail: Under a Nov 2025 MoU (not yet a confirmed live product), Dukhan is to be the exclusive distributor of Global Infrastructure Partners' Shariah-compliant private-market products in Qatar's consumer banking market, for HNW and corporate investors, with joint product development planned. TFI runs real estate funds and private equity.
islamic_wealth_detail: All products are Shari'a-compliant: sukuk (Qatar, GCC, international), Shari'a-compliant GCC equity portfolios, funds, capital-protected products and Islamic hedging.
asset_classes: Local equities; GCC equities; Mutual funds; Sukuk; Structured products; Private markets / alternatives; Real estate funds

Offers personalised advisory, alternative investments, public equities, fixed income, structured and capital-protected products, term deposits and periodic investor reporting. The website enquiry form lists real estate, health care, education, technology, structured products, term deposit and capital-protected options with USD amounts.

Fund vehicles include QFB Money Market Fund 1, LB Income Fund, LB Real Estate Equity Fund 1 and LB Galaxy PE Fund (2026). Group AUM was QAR 19.2bn at 30 Jun 2026. digital_investing_detail: No client app or online investing platform found. Digital work in 2025 was internal: a core banking upgrade, a cloud ERP and ISO 20022 messaging.

discretionary_detail: The AR 2025 cites 'growth in discretionary mandates' in public equity, fixed income and money market, and 'portfolio management' within Private Wealth. Licensed for managing investments.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: None found.
funds_platform_detail: Own funds and investment vehicles only. No third-party fund shelf was found. Planned: Qatar and GCC equity funds, a sukuk fund and an ETF (H1 2026 strategy).
structured_products_detail: Operations supported 44 structured investment products in 2025, including 19 new launches. Capital-protected and structured products are offered to private clients, and Treasury covers structured products.
private_markets_detail: This is the core proposition. Clients are offered syndicated private equity, real estate (US, Europe; Qatar REIT planned), aviation (5 B777-300ER, 4 A350-1000; 33 aircraft from Avolon agreed Sep 2026; managed fleet above 75 aircraft) and infrastructure (Edinburgh Airport stake; co-investment with GIP). End-2025 PE AUM was QAR 4.5bn and real estate AUM QAR 4.5bn.
islamic_wealth_detail: Entire bank is Shari'a-compliant. The Shari'a Supervisory Board approves every deal. Products include sukuk (QAR 2.9bn own book), Shari'a-compliant structured products and alternatives.

private_banking_detail: Private Banking for HNW and affluent families, with a dedicated Private Relationship Manager and four areas: investment planning and asset management, credit planning and management, wealth protection, and business planning for private business owners. No products, platform or thresholds are published. The LEAD 2024-2027 strategy prioritises Private and Premier Banking. Al Rayan Bank UK also serves GCC-based Premier clients from London.
asset_management_detail: Al Rayan Investment L.L.C. (100%, est. 2007; QFCRA-authorised, QFMA-regulated; all products Shari'a-compliant). AUM was QAR 3.9bn at end-2025 across money markets, public equities and sukuk. All assets are managed in-house, with a GCC and Turkey focus. Products: segregated portfolios for governments, pension funds, corporates, family offices and HNW individuals; Al Rayan GCC Fund (over QAR 390m; -6% in 2025); Al Rayan Qatar ETF QATR (about QAR 460m market cap, TER 0.50%, tracks the QE Al Rayan Islamic Index); a third regulated fund; USD sukuk portfolios (about +9% net in 2025). Led by Acting CEO Akber Khan; Head of AM Zohaib Pervez.
brokerage_detail: No in-house broker. Sahl Plus (launched 12 May 2026 with The Group) lets customers link bank accounts to their investment accounts at The Group, trade on QSE and transfer funds within minutes through the AlRayan Bank mobile app. ARI offers a sukuk execution service to institutional and individual investors, with sukuk held in custody by ARI.
digital_investing_detail: AlRayan GO app (launched 9 Dec 2024; AI-avatar campaign May 2025; goal-based 'Pockets' savings). In-app investing is limited to QSE trading via The Group (Sahl Plus, May 2026). No in-app purchase of funds, sukuk or international equities was found. QATR can be bought on QSE.
advisory_detail: Private Banking gives investment planning and holistic financial analysis through relationship managers. ARI gives customised investment solutions and financial and strategic advisory.
discretionary_detail: ARI manages segregated portfolios ('bespoke solutions' by goal and risk tolerance) for institutions, family offices and HNW individuals. No retail discretionary product was found at the bank.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No robo-advisor or model-portfolio product found on bank, ARI or app pages.
funds_platform_detail: Only ARI in-house funds (QATR, Al Rayan GCC Fund, third fund) were found; no third-party fund shelf or platform provider is published. Off-balance sheet AUM includes 'mutual funds and other securities' (S2), which may be client holdings.
structured_products_detail: Treasury lists structured deposits and hedging solutions among Shari'a-compliant treasury products. No investment-grade structured notes for wealth clients were found.
private_markets_detail: No private equity, private credit or real estate fund offer for clients found. ARI advises on IPOs, sukuk and M&A (corporate advisory, not client investment products).
islamic_wealth_detail: Whole group is Shari'a-compliant (AAOIFI). Products: Shari'a-compliant GCC equity/sukuk fund, the Islamic Qatar ETF (QATR), USD sukuk portfolios and sukuk execution.
asset_classes: Local equities; GCC equities; ETFs; Mutual funds; Sukuk

private_banking_detail: QIB Private (Shari'a-compliant private banking 'since 1995'). Certified RMs; a priority private banking centre at QIB Al Sadd branch; door-to-door or fully digital onboarding; multi-currency accounts and deposits; investments (sukuk, real estate, international equities, ESG-focused deposit, structured investment products, mutual funds, FX); investment advisory with active portfolio management; financing against investment portfolios; 24x7 private hotline and video banking with e-signatures. Named Qatar's Best Private Bank by Euromoney (Private Banking Awards 2026). QIB UK also runs a private banking team, under its CCO.
asset_management_detail: No in-house asset management subsidiary or proprietary fund range was found at the bank. QInvest LLC (49% associate since 2025, QFC-licensed) is the group's investment bank / asset manager and is profiled separately as qa-qinvest. The bank's only AUM line is off-balance-sheet AUM of QAR 10.5m.
brokerage_detail: Via partner, not in-house: customers with a brokerage account at The Group Securities Company and a National Investor Number link it in the QIB Mobile App ('My Products' > 'Brokerage'). They can trade QSE-listed stocks in real time, move funds instantly between bank and brokerage accounts, see net worth and portfolio, and use a single sign-on. Qatar only.
digital_investing_detail: QIB Mobile App (320+ features): in-app QSE equity trading through The Group Securities (launched 8 Jul 2021), IPO subscription services, and viewing of deposits and investments. Private Banking clients get portfolio monitoring, transactions and secure messaging/video with RMs. Tamayuz and Private customers have a dedicated interface. No in-app funds, sukuk or international equities purchase found. AI-powered features for analysing customer behaviour were added in 2025.
advisory_detail: Investment advisory and personalised wealth planning by certified Private Banking RMs; Tamayuz clients get 'expert financial recommendations' and access to sukuk and portfolio diversification in Qatar and globally.
discretionary_detail: The Private Banking page says QIB will 'actively manage your portfolio', but no discretionary mandate product, terms or manager were found.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No robo-advisor or model-portfolio offering found on the personal, Private Banking, Tamayuz or mobile-app pages or in the Annual Report 2025.
funds_platform_detail: Private Banking lists 'mutual funds' among investment opportunities, but no fund shelf, fund names or platform provider is published.
structured_products_detail: 'Structured investment products' are offered to Private Banking customers (no issuers or terms published).
private_markets_detail: Private Banking offers 'real estate investments' (Qatar and abroad via a network of projects) but no private equity, private credit or fund-based private-markets product was found. QIB UK finances prime London real estate.
islamic_wealth_detail: Fully Shari'a-compliant: sukuk, Shari'a-screened equities, structured investments, mutual funds and real estate for Private Banking; Sustainable Flexi CD; Afaq savings takaful plan; QSE trading via The Group Securities.
asset_classes: Local equities; US/international equities; Mutual funds; Sukuk; Structured products; Real estate funds

model_portfolios_robo_detail: None found.
funds_platform_detail: 'Investment funds' are listed among Treasury & Investment services for customers, with no fund names or platform.
structured_products_detail: None found.
private_markets_detail: 'Equity participation' and 'private equity' are listed among Treasury & Investment services offered to customers, with no products named.
islamic_wealth_detail: Fully Shari'a-compliant bank. Customers can access sukuk, investment funds and equity and private-equity participation through Treasury & Investments.

funds_platform_detail: No third-party fund shelf or platform found.

private_banking_detail: QNB Private in Qatar, which QNB calls the first private bank established in Qatar. It offers a dedicated private banker, banking, real estate services and advisory, asset and wealth management, Lombard/special lending, and access to QNB private banking in Switzerland, France and the UK. Offshore hub: QNB (Suisse) SA in Geneva (FINMA): open-architecture investing, equities and fixed income trading, structured products, QNB and third-party mutual and hedge funds, GCC and global brokerage and custody, Lombard and real-estate lending, Islamic solutions, UHNW concierge. 2025: AUM up ~50%, loans and deposits up ~7%, clients up 3%, ~30% Qatar market share; RMs got a new 360-degree client dashboard; a specialised wealth management system for client reporting is in development. Awards: Euromoney and MEED Best Private Bank in Qatar 2025; Global Finance Best Private Bank in the Middle East and Qatar 2025.
asset_management_detail: In-house division (Group Asset and Wealth Management; no separate asset-management legal entity found). AUM QR 29bn at end-2025 (+12%), revenue +7.7%; in-house funds averaged 330 bps net outperformance (S8). Funds: Al Watani Fund (Qatari blue chips), QNB MENA Debt Fund, QNB Sukuk Fund, QNB MENA Equity Fund, QNB Commodity Fund, and QNB Money Market Fund (launched 2025). QNB Suisse fund range: MENA Equities, MENA Debt, Global Sukuk, Spinel RC Fund, Global Funds ICAV. Two thematic portfolios launched in 2025 (AI/digital infrastructure; renewables/climate transition). Plans for cross-border fund structures and more automation and digital client tools in 2026.
brokerage_detail: QNB Financial Services WLL (QNBFS), wholly owned, brokerage since May 2011. QSE market share 46% in 2025 (33% 2023, 37% 2024); ~10% share of retail investors; 100% share of bonds and T-bill transactions; market maker and liquidity provider for 39 listed companies; only Qatari broker with equity research (30 companies). Markets: Qatar (web and mobile), GCC and Egypt (via desk), US/European equities, ETFs and primary issues (desk), global trading via Interactive Brokers, primary and secondary bonds and sukuk, margin trading. Retail bond trading on QSE from QR 100,000 launched Dec 2025. Retail clients are reached through QNB branches. CEO Maha Mohamad Al-Sulaiti.
digital_investing_detail: Through QNBFS rather than the bank app: the QNBFS Trading app (iOS/Android) and web trading for QSE, with transfers between QNB accounts and investment accounts. QNBFS is trialling a single integrated retail trading platform across Qatar, GCC, US and Europe with consolidated portfolio view, expected to launch in 2026, and is exploring AI-driven tailored recommendations (Annual Report 2025). No evidence found that the QNB Mobile banking app in Qatar sells funds or securities. Enpara (Türkiye) and the planned ezbank digital banks focus on banking, not investing, in the sources checked.
advisory_detail: End-to-end advisory by Group AWM (S8). The QNB Wealth Solutions team designs fund portfolios by region, asset class and manager (S12). Private bankers advise HNW clients, and QNB Suisse provides investment advisory (S16, S18).
discretionary_detail: Discretionary mandates are available: clients can assign portfolio management to QNB's Asset Management Division under agreed guidelines. Portfolio types include equities, commodities, Qatar/GCC/EM, fixed income and balanced, plus tailor-made or capital-guaranteed structures and ESG themes (Portfolio Management Services page). Aggregate performance of QNB's QE (Qatar equity) portfolios is published in the Annual Report.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: No robo-advisor or digital model-portfolio service found. Closest offers: Wealth Solutions' custom fund portfolios (advisor-led), and the MetLife-underwritten International Wealth Builder savings plan with conservative, balanced or aggressive strategies.
funds_platform_detail: Third-party international funds are selected from the Allfunds Bank platform, then screened by the Asset Management Division and reviewed monthly; all must be UCITS and no-load. The monthly white list has 23 funds (20 third-party; 17 SFDR Art. 8). Managers include Goldman Sachs, Fidelity, Schroders, Allianz, BNP Paribas, Pictet, Amundi, Janus Henderson and Old Mutual. The open-architecture platform added aerospace and defence, healthcare and sustainable infrastructure funds in 2025.
structured_products_detail: Demand for structured solutions grew >15% in 2025, led by reverse convertibles; longer-term reverse convertibles and multi-asset baskets were added; private banking clients favour capital-protected and yield-enhancing notes (S8). QNB Suisse offers structured products (S18); QNB AWM offers capital-guaranteed structures (S14).
private_markets_detail: No private equity, private credit or other private-markets fund offering found. The Annual Report mentions investor appetite for 'alternative assets' and structured products giving diversified asset pools; the white list's 'alternatives' are a listed global property equity fund and a gold fund. QNB Suisse lists third-party hedge funds.
islamic_wealth_detail: QNB Sukuk Fund (USD sukuk from governments, agencies and corporates) and QNB Suisse Global Sukuk Fund; Old Mutual Global Islamic Equity fund on the white list; QNB Suisse Islamic solutions (Wakala, reverse Murabaha); QNBFS secondary sukuk trading. QNB Capital arranges sukuk (IFN Deal of the Year 2025 awards, Oct 2026).

discretionary_detail: Al Rajhi Capital lists 'Discretionary Portfolio Management' under asset management (S44). Size not disclosed.

Website categories: liquidity and fixed income, public equity, multi-asset, alternative, private funds and REITs. 2025: 18 new products per SNB's annual report (20 new funds per SNB Capital's own report), including 13 private real estate funds, a waqf fund and three international credit funds. Per its own report: Moody's MQ1 (highest) investment-quality rating and a 2025 'best multi-asset manager' award from Forbes Middle East. Namaa Endowment Fund (Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture) appointed SNB Capital as manager in Feb 2026.
brokerage_detail: Saudi Exchange: #1 broker, 14% of H1 2026 value traded (SAR 175bn); more than 15% in 2025; over 25% of retail IPO subscriptions. Channels: AlAhli Tadawul online, mobile app and IVR, VIP trading lounges across the Kingdom, free live prices, Mubasher Net and Mubasher Pro. International: '30 markets' per the website (US, UK, UAE, Kuwait, Egypt, Oman, Bahrain and several European and Asian markets in the price list), with Interactive Brokers named as execution partner (IBKR Pro, IBKR Lite, US options) and a separate 'GTN' schedule for Asia-Pacific, US and GCC/Arab markets; nearly USD 8bn traded in 2025 (+44%). Margin financing (+about 40% in 2025), securities lending, employee share plans, custody (AUC SAR 155bn) and a market-access service for foreign institutions (over 150,000 end-client accounts opened).
digital_investing_detail: 'SNB Capital' app (iOS, seller The Saudi National Bank; v2.20.19, updated 11 Sep 2026; first released 24 Dec 2020; 2,116 ratings, average 2.81): trading, dashboard, order placing, cash transfers to and from portfolios. AlAhli Tadawul online platform and mobile app for Saudi and international markets; Idikhari goal-based savings is enrolled inside the SNB Capital app. Fund subscriptions in-app were not confirmed by the listing. Chief Digital Officer role exists (Loai Bafaqeeh).
advisory_detail: CMA licence includes advising; Wealth Management is a standalone division. A LinkedIn search snippet suggested a 'Head of Investment Advisory and Solutions' role from May 2026; not verified, not recorded as a person.
discretionary_detail: Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) listed under Asset Management ('expert-led strategies aligned with investors' goals and risk profiles across all asset classes'); assets held in a fiduciary capacity for the parent bank were SAR 1.76bn at end-2025 (note 21). No DPM minimum published.
model_portfolios_robo_detail: Idikhari (individual savings plan) in the SNB Capital app: goal-based plans (vehicle, education, wedding, property, travel, savings, retirement) that assess goal, savings and risk appetite, recommend one Shariah-compliant fund per plan (SNB Capital SAR Multi-Asset Conservative, Moderate or Growth funds, or Al Sunbullah SAR) and automate standing-order contributions from SAR 100. This is single-fund recommendation, not multi-asset model portfolios. SNB's AR 2025 says a robo-advisory platform 'is being added to the portfolio of Wealth Management services'; no launch found. Feb 2024 MoU with fintech Mala'a (digital financial planning, automated investing).
funds_platform_detail: SNB Capital distributes its own funds (app, AlAhli Tadawul, SNB branches). No third-party fund shelf or fund-platform provider found. Feb 2026 Investcorp partnership covers asset management, investment banking and wealth management for alternatives (private equity, real assets, credit), scope of distribution not specified.
structured_products_detail: No structured products on the SNB Capital website pages opened. SNB Capital won a 'Best in Saudi Arabia' award for Islamic Structured Finance in July 2026 (corporate finance, per media list). private_markets_detail: Alternatives are a core line: real estate funds (e.g. SEDCO Residential Development Fund, SNB Capital Real Estate Fund, AlAhli REIT Fund (1)), private equity and venture, 13 private real estate funds launched in 2025. SNB Capital (DIFC) Limited (DFSA-regulated, over SAR 7.5bn AUM, undated) manages 14 named funds: aviation (I, II), credit (I, II, IV), real estate credit (I, II), asset-backed income, GP stakes, Pan-European real estate, oil and gas, strategic equity, private equity solutions, software opportunities. Parent group also holds SNB Capital Dubai Inc. (private equity and real estate in emerging markets). Wealth Managers' Coverage offers access to private equity, real estate and hedge funds. Investcorp partnership (Feb 2026) for private equity, real assets, credit; Orion partnership (Jan 2026) for mining.
islamic_wealth_detail: SNB Capital's AR says its products and services are Shariah-compliant and that it is the largest Shariah-compliant asset manager in the world; all public funds on the website state Shariah compliance or track MSCI Islamic M-Series indices (equity, sukuk, murabaha/money market, waqf funds, Sadaqqat charity fund). Whole-firm Shariah-only status is not stated in the audited statements, which include Tier 1 Sukuk, bank borrowings and margin lending, so 'model' is left as Not applicable.
